message.reasoning_content: We need to determine appropriate charge(s) based on facts. The facts: leaf: defendant Ye made fake company seals (company, financial, legal representative) for two companies. He engaged a fake seal vendor, got six seals, which were forged. This is forging and selling state? Actually these are company seals, not state documents. The list includes "伪造、变造、买卖国家机关公文、证件、印章" (for state documents) and "伪造公司、企业、事业单位、人民团体印章" (for company seals). The appropriate label is "伪造公司、企业、事业单位、人民团体印章". Also possibly "伪造、变造、买卖国家机关公文、证件、印章" is not correct because not state. So answer: [罪名]伪造公司、企业、事业单位、人民团体印章<eoa>.
